in_sanskrit.name: Tayal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mountains
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tayal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Tayal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Trayala', which means 'Lord of the mountains'. This name is often given to children born in mountainous regions or to those who are believed to have a strong connection to the mountains.
